title: Double-Shot Volley and the Opening of a Fierce Battle

blocks.text: The defenders answered the assault with prepared gunfire, loading two bullets in each musket before the enemy closed in. One or two Mughals fell with each shot, and the first ranks of the assaulting force collapsed almost as soon as they reached the killing ground.

Bodies piled upon bodies until even horses hesitated over the corpses strewn before the breached approaches. The effect of the volleys was not just physical but psychological, briefly checking the momentum of troops who had expected plunder rather than disciplined resistance.

Yet the assault did not end there, because fresh pressure kept coming through broken walls and openings. The page closes by widening from the musket volleys into a fierce battle that would continue through the next stage of the fort fight.
